description: CarsXE is a B2B vehicle data platform from PiWaves, LLC. It provides VIN decoding, plate decoding, vehicle history, market value, recalls, OCR/recognition, year-make-model data, lien/theft checks, and related automotive data services.
summary: CarsXE exposes a vehicle-data REST API on `api.carsxe.com`, a hosted MCP server on `mcp.carsxe.com`, a public docs-search MCP on `docs.carsxe.com/mcp`, and the `carsxe` CLI; the main developer auth is a CarsXE API key, while the hosted MCP server also supports self-onboarding OAuth for compatible remote MCP clients.
